title: Crawl speed and schedule
lead: How often we fetch your robots.txt, how gently, and when to stay away.

items.title: Frequency
items.text: Every 15 minutes, hourly, every 6 hours or daily. The shorter intervals depend on your plan.

items.title: Speed
items.text: Gentle, normal or fast: requests per second and how many at once.

items.title: Window and timezone
items.text: Stay off your peak hours, and pause while you deploy.

items.title: Our identity
items.text: The user agent we send and the addresses we come from, so you can allowlist us in a firewall.

items.title: Save, or crawl now
items.text: The next-crawl time in the header updates as soon as you save.

blocks.text: Our crawler explains itself at sus.bot/bot, including how to block it.
